Question: Of the following, which best approximates the ratio of the number of nonterminal nodes to the total number of nodes in a complete K-ary tree of depth N?

Options: 
A. N/K
B. (N-1)/K
C. K-1/K
D. N-1/m
E. log_10 (1/N)
F. 1/N
G. (K-1)/N
H. K/N
I. 1/(K-1)
J. 1/K

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

The ratio of nonterminal nodes to the total number of nodes is $I/T \approx \frac{K^N}{K^{N+1}} = \frac{1}{K}$. This matches Option J. While Option C $(K-1)/K$ represents the ratio of terminal nodes to total nodes, Option J is the correct ratio for internal nodes as the question asks.
